examples.scenario: Phishing email targeting CFO with personalized invoice request

email.subject: Urgent: Approval Needed for Vendor Invoice Payment
email.body:
Hi John,

I just got off the call with our supplier, and they need immediate payment for the recent shipment. Please approve the attached invoice so we can avoid any delays. Let me know if you have questions.

Thanks,
Sarah

indicators: Email spoofed to appear from CEO's address
Urgency and pressure to approve payment quickly
Attachment potentially containing malware or credential harvesting
Personalized with CFO's name and recent vendor info from company records
examples.risk: Potential financial loss due to fraudulent payment approval

examples.scenario: Whaling email exploiting CEO’s recent conference attendance

email.subject: Follow-up and Exclusive Offer from Tech Innovators Summit
email.body:
Dear Emily,

It was a pleasure meeting you at the Tech Innovators Summit last week. Attached is the summary of sessions you attended, along with a special invitation to our upcoming private webinar.

Please review the attached PDF for details and RSVP at your earliest convenience.

Best regards,
Mark Davis

indicators: Email references recent CEO activity (conference attendance)
Attachment may contain malicious macros or phishing links
Sender address mimics legitimate event partner domain but slightly altered
Request encourages opening attachment and clicking links
examples.risk: Possible credential theft leading to data breach or network compromise

examples.scenario: Fake HR email to CMO about confidential executive bonus details

email.subject: Confidential: Executive Bonus Review Required
email.body:
Hello Alex,

As part of the annual review, please confirm your bonus details by accessing the secure link below. This information is confidential and requires your immediate attention.

[Secure Link]

indicators: Appears to come from internal HR but domain spoofed or compromised
Urgent call to action to click on a link for confidential info
Link redirects to a phishing site mimicking company login portal
Targets CMO with information related to personal compensation
examples.risk: Credential compromise leading to unauthorized access and data leakage
